title: Charleston and Laudato Si, a prayer …
excerpt: Living God, help humanity see how the same violence of heart that destroys precious human lives with bullets of hate destroys the planet for pockets of money. Humble us, convert us, teach us to love, make us instruments of healing and peace. Amen.
